# Kosovo

[global-law](../) / Kosovo

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 98% | 66% | 46% |

Nearly every law in the Official Gazette's lists is held (1,108 of about 1,133 laws and codes), with all 7 essentials, plus 2,745 Constitutional Court rulings. But everything is held as enacted. The Constitution file is the 2008 text (it still has art. 143, which was deleted in 2012, and lacks the 2020 Istanbul Convention paragraph), and the Criminal and Criminal Procedure Codes lack their 2023 amendments, although the Gazette has published official consolidated texts of all three (2024-2026) that the repository lists but does not use.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
